fields.description:
Plain text. Words in braces are filled in from the document:
{first_name} {last_name} {customer_name} {order_number} {order_total} {order_date} {order_status} {payment_method} {items} {item_count} {shop_name} {order_url} {admin_url}
{order_url} only opens for customers with a portal login, and {admin_url} only for you. A misspelt word is removed rather than sent.

Cancelling cascades: cancelling an invoice usually cancels its delivery and payment too, so switch on only the cancel message your customers would recognise.
